target_fidelity.note: “Walk carefully.” is a positive active imperative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The wet-floor context makes the instruction coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: The prompt permits many equally natural imperatives, so it does not isolate a single focused production response.

determinacy.note: Responses such as “Be careful,” “Don’t slip,” or “Watch your step” also fit, but are not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: The item can be answered using a simple imperative without unrelated advanced grammar.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is needed.
